description: Paid wire-bound x402 v2 preflight. Give FOXIFY the merchant's actual PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge, exact intended HTTP request and independent caller authority; FOXIFY derives payment facts and returns advisory ALLOW, REVIEW or DENY evidence. Costs $0.05 USDC on Base.

accept_index.description: Explicit accepted-payment index when the challenge contains multiple eligible exact-USDC options.

signature_verified.description: Whether the caller asserts that its agent identity/signature was independently verified.

authorization.description: Independent caller authority. Merchant PAYMENT-REQUIRED facts never authorize themselves.

allowed_asset_transfer_methods.description: Optional EVM transfer-method allowlist. Defaults to eip3009 only.

allowed_domains.description: Merchant domains independently authorized by the caller.

allowed_payment_flows.description: Optional x402 payment-flow allowlist. Defaults to authorization only.

expected_recipient.description: Recipient required by caller authority; compared with the merchant challenge payTo.

human_confirmed.description: Whether the caller asserts that required human confirmation has occurred.

max_amount_atomic.description: Maximum atomic USDC amount independently authorized by the caller.

intended_request.description: Exact HTTP request bound to the merchant x402 challenge.

method.description: Exact HTTP method the buyer intends to execute.

url.description: Exact resource URL the buyer intends to execute.

payment_required.description: Raw x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header value or its decoded object.

name: verify_x402_payment_required
title: Verify x402 Payment Required
